rows.name: protected_valid_wrapper
rows.code: o = create($nothing); add_property($server_options, "protect_valid", 1, {player, "r"}); add_verb(#0, {player, "rxd", "bf_valid"}, {"this", "none", "this"}); set_verb_code(#0, "bf_valid", {"return valid(args[1]) + 10;"}); load_server_options(); n = 0; try for i in [1..70000]; n = n + valid(o) + valid(#-1); endfor; finally delete_verb(#0, "bf_valid"); delete_property($server_options, "protect_valid"); load_server_options(); recycle(o); endtry; return n;

rows.name: map_get_put_100
rows.code: m = []; for i in [1..100]; m["k" + tostr(i)] = i; endfor; for r in [1..200]; for i in [1..100]; k = "k" + tostr(i); m[k] = m[k] + 1; endfor; endfor; s = 0; for v, k in (m); s = s + v + length(k); endfor; return {length(m), s};

rows.name: map_small_get_put
rows.code: m = ["hp" -> 10, "mp" -> 5, "str" -> 3, "dex" -> 4, "gold" -> 0]; for i in [1..100000]; m["gold"] = m["gold"] + 1; m["hp"] = m["hp"] + (i % 2); if (m["mp"] < 100) m["mp"] = m["mp"] + 1; endif; endfor; return {m["gold"], m["hp"], m["mp"], length(m)};

rows.name: callers_chain
rows.code: o = create($nothing); for v in ({"a", "b", "c"}); add_verb(o, {player, "rxd", v}, {"this", "none", "this"}); endfor; set_verb_code(o, "a", {"return this:b(args[1]);"}); set_verb_code(o, "b", {"return this:c(args[1]);"}); set_verb_code(o, "c", {"cs = callers(); return args[1] + length(cs);"}); n = 0; for i in [1..25000]; n = n + o:a(i); endfor; recycle(o); return n;

rows.name: prop_write_growing_list
rows.code: o = create($nothing); add_property(o, "log", {}, {player, "rw"}); for i in [1..5000]; o.log = {@o.log, i}; endfor; n = length(o.log); recycle(o); return n;

rows.name: list_member_setadd
rows.code: l = {}; for i in [1..500]; l = {@l, i * 3}; endfor; n = 0; s = {}; for i in [1..20000]; if (i in l) n = n + 1; endif; s = setadd(s, i % 50); s = setremove(s, (i + 25) % 50); endfor; l2 = listappend(l, 7); return {n, length(s), length(l2)};

rows.name: raise_through_verb
rows.code: o = create($nothing); add_verb(o, {player, "rxd", "boom"}, {"this", "none", "this"}); set_verb_code(o, "boom", {"if (args[1] % 3) raise(E_INVARG, \"bad\", args[1]); endif; return args[1];"}); c = 0; for i in [1..80000]; try c = c + o:boom(i); except e (E_INVARG) c = c + e[3]; endtry; endfor; recycle(o); return c;

rows.name: string_mix
rows.code: n = 0; for i in [1..20000]; s = "The quick brown fox " + tostr(i) + " jumps over"; n = n + index(s, "fox") + length(strsub(s, "quick", "slow")) + toint(s[21..20 + length(tostr(i))]); if (match(s, "[0-9]+")) n = n + 1; endif; if (rmatch(s, "over$")) n = n + 1; endif; endfor; return n;

rows.name: recursion_40
rows.code: o = create($nothing); add_verb(o, {player, "rxd", "r"}, {"this", "none", "this"}); set_verb_code(o, "r", {"if (args[1] >= 40) return args[1]; endif; return this:r(args[1] + 1);"}); n = 0; for i in [1..3000]; n = n + o:r(0); endfor; recycle(o); return n;

rows.name: verb_chain_6deep
rows.code: o = create($nothing); for i in [1..6]; add_verb(o, {player, "rxd", "f" + tostr(i)}, {"this", "none", "this"}); endfor; for i in [1..5]; set_verb_code(o, "f" + tostr(i), {"return this:f" + tostr(i + 1) + "(args[1] + 1, args[2], args[3]);"}); endfor; set_verb_code(o, "f6", {"return args[1] + length(args[2]) + args[3];"}); n = 0; for i in [1..20000]; n = n + o:f1(i, {1, 2, 3}, 7); endfor; recycle(o); return n;

rows.name: for_in_list_1000
rows.code: l = {}; for i in [1..1000]; l = {@l, i}; endfor; c = 0; s = 0; for r in [1..1000]; for x in (l); s = s + x % 7; if (x > 500) c = c + 1; endif; endfor; endfor; return {c, s};

rows.name: sysobj_verb_calls
rows.code: o = create($nothing); add_verb(o, {player, "rxd", "util"}, {"this", "none", "this"}); set_verb_code(o, "util", {"return args[1] * 2 + length(args[2]);"}); add_property(#0, "bd_util", o, {player, "r"}); n = 0; try for i in [1..80000]; n = n + $bd_util:util(i, "abc"); endfor; finally delete_property(#0, "bd_util"); recycle(o); endtry; return n;

rows.name: sysprop_reads
rows.code: n = 0; for i in [1..150000]; if ($nothing == #-1 && valid($server_options)) n = n + 1; endif; x = $object; y = $waif; z = $anonymous; endfor; return n;

rows.name: valid_typeof_loop
rows.code: o = create($nothing); vals = {1, 1.5, "s", {1}, o, #-1, E_PERM, [1 -> 2]}; n = 0; for i in [1..60000]; for v in (vals); n = n + typeof(v); if (typeof(v) == OBJ && valid(v)) n = n + 100; endif; endfor; endfor; recycle(o); return n;

rows.name: inherited_prop_6anc
rows.code: root = create($nothing); add_property(root, "depth", 3, {player, "r"}); add_property(root, "label", "ancestor", {player, "r"}); objs = {root}; p = root; for i in [1..6]; c = create(p); objs = {@objs, c}; p = c; endfor; leaf = p; n = 0; for i in [1..100000]; n = n + leaf.depth + length(leaf.label); endfor; while (objs); recycle(objs[$]); objs = objs[1..$ - 1]; endwhile; return n;

rows.name: try_except_raise
rows.code: c = 0; for i in [1..45000]; try if (i % 2) raise(E_INVARG); else raise(E_PERM, "nope"); endif; except e (E_INVARG) c = c + 1; except e (ANY) c = c + 2; endtry; endfor; return c;

rows.name: catch_propnf_loop
rows.code: o = create($nothing); add_property(o, "cache", 5, {player, "r"}); n = 0; for i in [1..12000]; n = n + `o.cache ! E_PROPNF => 0' + `o.help_msg ! E_PROPNF => 0' + `o.aliases ! E_PROPNF => 1'; endfor; recycle(o); return n;
